title: THE PIXEL DOWNED AND DEAD
why: His picks a14 B (kneel in a pulsing ring), a15 B (the player falls and turns to light) and a23 B (a pillager bot falls and fades) from the art survey, and his 10-20 orders for the pixel art pass. Job 86g, ship 2: the downed, the dead and the fallen are pixel figures instead of the old vector ones.
now: A downed player kneels in a pulsing red pixel ring with the gun on the floor; a dead player and a falling pillager bot topple in baked pixel frames and fade.
